subject.title: RFC: Org claim disputes and account recovery

question: Should the current namespace-claim docs/form and guarded account-recovery tooling be accepted as the final RFC outcome, or do maintainers require additional public/private policy before closing this RFC?
rationale: The remaining work is a trust, ownership, and auth-boundary policy decision; automation can verify the partial implementation but cannot choose final evidence standards or private reviewer boundaries.

options.title: Accept With Synthesis
options.body: Post the maintainer synthesis, identify any small docs/spec/runbook follow-ups, and close the RFC only after the accepted outcome is recorded.

options.title: Keep In Review
options.body: Leave the RFC open for more community/security feedback if evidence standards or deleted-owner outcomes are still unsettled.

options.title: Supersede Explicitly
options.body: If a newer policy item now owns the decision, close this RFC only by linking that canonical replacement.

recommendation.title: Accept With Synthesis
recommendation.body: Post the maintainer synthesis, identify any small docs/spec/runbook follow-ups, and close the RFC only after the accepted outcome is recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the RFC and most current namespace/recovery policy implementation and is listed on relevant CODEOWNERS entries.
